2607.09936.title: SMETA-ZSL:Semantic Meta-Alignment for Zero-Shot Threat Classification
2607.09936.paper_summary: Cybersecurity systems must adapt rapidly to emerging threats. However, labeled data for new threat categories is unavailable when those threats first appear. Generalized zero-shot learning offers a natural solution by enabling recognition of unseen classes through auxiliary semantic knowledge rather than labeled examples. Large language models are particularly promising in this setting because they can convert unstructured CTI reports into semantic prototypes for emerging threats. However, applying language-driven zero-shot learning to cybersecurity is difficult due to strong semantic overlap between threat descriptions, heterogeneity between behavioral attributes and text, severe class imbalance, and open-set conditions where unseen threats are unknown during training. We propose SMETA-ZSL, that learns semantic prototypes from overlapping language descriptions through contrastive finetuning, aligns behavioral features through episodic meta-learning and knowledge distillation, and performs adaptive routing for generalization across seen-unseen classes. Across 7 benchmarks, SMETA-ZSL delivers the strongest overall generalized zero-shot performance under the strictest inductive setting, surpassing prior methods by 10.8 points on average, with gains up to 18.1 points. Github:https://github.com/Security-And-Intelligence-Lab-UTEP/SMETA-ZSL
2607.09936.paper_summary_zh: 網路安全系統必須迅速適應新興威脅。<lb/>然而，當這些威脅首次出現時，對於新威脅類別的標記數據是不可用的。<lb/>通用的零樣本學習提供了一個自然的解決方案，通過輔助語義知識而非標記示例來實現對未見類別的識別。<lb/>大型語言模型在這種情境下特別有前景，因為它們可以將非結構化的CTI報告轉換為新興威脅的語義原型。<lb/>然而，將基於語言的零樣本學習應用於網路安全是困難的，因為威脅描述之間存在強烈的語義重疊、行為屬性與文本之間的異質性、嚴重的類別不平衡，以及在訓練期間未知的未見威脅的開放集條件。<lb/>我們提出了SMETA-ZSL，它通過對比微調從重疊的語言描述中學習語義原型，通過情節元學習和知識蒸餾對齊行為特徵，並對已見-未見類別進行自適應路由以實現泛化。<lb/>在7個基準測試中，SMETA-ZSL在最嚴格的歸納設置下提供了最強的整體通用零樣本性能，平均超過先前方法10.8分，增益高達18.1分。<lb/>Github:https://github.com/Security-And-Intelligence-Lab-UTEP/SMETA-ZSL
